Tatum tallied 15 points and five rebounds in the first quarter, marking just the second instance in the play-by-play era in which a Celtic reached those numbers in an opening frame.
The only other Celtic to reach those numbers in any quarter during that span was Paul Pierce, who did so in the third period of a matchup against the Utah Jazz on Nov. 11, 2002.

Tatum went on to finish with a season-high 41 points, marking his highest scoring output since before his Achilles rupture, dating back to a 46-point performance against the Cleveland Cavaliers on Feb. 28, 2025.
It was also his highest-scoring road performance since he dropped 43 points in Chicago on Dec. 21, 2024.
Neemias Queta poured in 21 points, marking the third 20-point effort of his career and his second straight against the Wizards.
